projection.units: km according to DAMIT calibrated-size flag; reconciled to declared equivalent diameter

surfaces.coverage: ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by VLT/SPHERE images. Selected archive volume-equivalent diameter: 141 ±2 km. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. The pinned mesh is an inverse model, not a directly sampled surface. No registered reflectance mosaic is supplied by this release; a neutral grid must mark unavailable imagery. Fine-scale craters, regolith and albedo are unresolved. Absolute rotational phase is illustrative. Select Vernazza et al. (2021) ADAM model5914 over older convex1086. The VLT/SPHERE imaging study reports volume-equivalent141 ±2 km, agreeing with the selected archive diameter and raw volume141.094. MPCD is a promising refinement documented in the paper; its linked LAM release could not be retrieved during this survey. The mounted source is the pinned ADAM mesh, not an unverified MPCD or reflectance product.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
